headline: 今日影剧速览：生化危机领跑，龙族热播
summary: 电影方面，《生化危机：爆发夜》等本周热作持续吸睛；剧集方面，《权力的游戏前传：龙族》热播，同时《复仇者联盟5》等待映片单引发期待。

industryHighlights.text: 《生化危机：爆发夜》领跑本周电影热作。
industryHighlights.en: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night tops this week's movie buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》等剧集持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: House of the Dragon and other series continue to draw viewers.

industryHighlights.text: 待映片单包括《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》《挖掘者》等。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films include Avengers 5, Mongoose, and The Digger.

headlineEn: Today's Screen Digest: Resident Evil Leads, Dragon Heats Up
summaryEn: On film, Resident Evil: Outbreak Night leads this week's hot titles; on TV, House of the Dragon stays popular, while upcoming Avengers 5 fuels anticipation.
